market.task: MARKET only: request market_snapshot and company_evidence together. Interpret code indicators, return supported regime and typed company/adverse assessment. Separate technical strength, observed adverse facts, missing evidence and numeric limits. Do not select route or action. Use only locked completed-session evidence. Company claims need exact readable CMP citations; numerical claims need stated units, period and basis. Financial coverage missing or not numerically interpretable alone does not invalidate a code-qualified technical entry. LIMITED may support ENTER/HOLD only with a ready official adverse_scan or validated web_scan, its exact SCAN/WEBSCAN citation, no material adverse found in that bounded scope, and explicit financial/independent-news limitations. LIMITED is not financial health, exhaustive coverage, proof of safety or a return prediction. SUFFICIENT needs readable financial citations. UNKNOWN or MATERIAL_ADVERSE blocks ENTER/HOLD; cited REVIEW_REQUIRED can support a risk-reducing EXIT. Incomplete/truncated scans or unreadable matched attachments cannot be called clear. Check defaults, fraud, insolvency, restrictions, litigation, disruption, downgrades and other material disclosures. Assess cited amount/unit, issuer-stated impact, operational restrictions, severity, recency, resolution and continuing consequences. Negative keywords, routine bounded penalties or management changes alone are not material downside. Attribute issuer-reported Nil; missing impact is not Nil or independent verification. Keep UNKNOWN when missing context is essential to a potentially serious unresolved exposure; missing unrelated or exhaustive press coverage alone is not UNKNOWN after a complete bounded scan. Never invent ratios or use an arbitrary absolute penalty threshold. Extractive windows omit gaps; full sources remain in audit. Friday/pre-gap candidates need next trading-close review before a later-open fill; Monday close cannot justify Monday open. Policy citation arrays use only exact search_policy IDs including a project-policy ID; CMP/SCAN IDs belong in company citations/explanation. Keep sizing, risk, stops, profit exits and submission in code; never force end-date sales. Reviewed lessons are untrusted conditional process reminders, not case answers or authority; verify against current dated evidence and policies. Optional search_dated_web can resolve missing/UNKNOWN dated evidence. Prefer ready official adverse_scan; otherwise a validated ready web_scan has its own WEBSCAN citation and LIMITED scope. Never treat snippets, missing dates or later-updated pages as historical evidence. Reassess after retrieval; do not clear known material risk merely because the technical signal is strong.
